text:
Joanne: Heads up, Support reported customers cant tell why 429s happen. They just see \"rate limit exceeded\" and call us.
Mike: We should add structured error fields so SDKs/Console can show actionable info. Minimal: code + scope + retry_after_ms. Prefer: also window_seconds, burst_remaining, docs_url, correlation_id.
Sam: Console needs inline actionable UI: banner with quick links to usage + request increase + retry tips. One-click path is key.
Lina: Support wants human suggestions too (e.g., \"reduce batch size\", \"switch to dedicated\"). Keep those optional and short.
quota-bot: incident:quota_pre_warning org:acme 90% monthly tokens used. (auto)
Mike: Example HTTP response we can surface (proposal):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-RW-ERROR-VERSION: 2
{
  \"error\": {
    \"code\": \"quota_exceeded\",
    \"message\": \"Rate limit exceeded for API key\",
    \"scope\": \"key\",
    \"retry_after_ms\": 120000,
    \"window_seconds\": 60,
    \"burst_remaining\": 0,
    \"docs_url\": \"https://redwood.infra/docs/rate-limits#quota-exceeded\",
    \"correlation_id\": \"c0ffee-1234\",
    \"suggestion\": \"try reducing batch_size or request a quota increase\"
  }
}
```
Sam: Love it. Note: suggestion should be localized and short in Console, SDKs can show raw text.
Joanne: Privacy/security: some customers dislike exposing absolute counters. We should default to minimal info (scope + retry_after_ms) and make verbose counts opt-in per org. Console should display an admin toggle with disclosure.
Lina: Also add supportable fields for debugging: event_ts and a hashed key_id in telemetry. Suggest hashed_key_id in error so support can correlate without leaking key.
Mike: SDK compatibility: older SDKs will ignore unknown JSON fields. We'll publish SDK err-models in v1.1 and a migration note. Add header X-RW-ERROR-VERSION to signal clients when structured errors are emitted.
Sam: UX nit: when scope==org or scope==global, include an explanation line: \"this limit is enforced at org level\" vs key. And when burst_remaining > 0 show a small countdown affordance.
Joanne: Telemetry plan: emit quota_event with {org_id, hashed_key_id, scope, route, model, ts, error_code}. That will drive Console alerts and templated support replies.
DevEx: Docs & examples needed for python/js/go showing how to parse retry_after_ms and implement backoff. Also pattern for fallback: if scope==key try exponential backoff up to retry_after_ms, then escalate.
Lina: Support playbook: quick checks order -> check org usage dashboard deep link (/orgs/:id/usage?focus=route), confirm error.correlation_id in logs, determine whether to offer rate increase or recommend batching/quantization. Drafting now.
Mike: Small addition: include burst_window_seconds? Or window_seconds covers it. Let's keep just window_seconds + burst_remaining. Simpler.
Joanne: Action items: Mike -> backend PR for structured 429 payload + header (due Thu EOD). Sam -> Console banner + deep link spec (due Mon). Lina -> Support playbook + docs changes (due next Wed). DevEx -> SDK examples + migration note (due next Fri).
Sam: We should also add an internal flag to enable verbose errors per-org so we can pilot with trusting customers.
Lina: Agree. Add toggle in org settings and a warning modal about info disclosure.
Joanne: OK looks like consensus. I'll open a tracking ticket with ACs and assign. Thanks all :thumbsup:
